purpose: Prevent unlike recovery, judgment, restitution, recoupment-opportunity, and cost-avoidance figures from being collapsed into one taxpayer-recovery total.
rules: potential_recovery is not fraud loss and is not cash recovered
judgments_and_recoveries is a mixed agency aggregate unless components are published
cost_avoidance is not cash returned to the treasury
joint-and-several or overlapping restitution orders must not be summed across defendants

entries.interpretation: DHS says more than $56M has been identified for recovery. This does not establish how much has actually been collected.
The Attorney General combines judgments and recoveries in one figure. Do not render this as $90M cash recovered unless a component ledger proves collection.

entries.period: Phase 1, late Oct. 2025-Jan. 2026 analysis of 46 months FFS paid claims
entries.interpretation: Optum defines these as funds that can be recouped for clearly defined policy violations. The report does not establish that the full amount was collected.
Potential corrective-action opportunities that may involve missing/vague policy and medical-necessity review. Not proven fraud, not identified final debt, and not collected.

entries.period: Q3 2025 to Q4 2025 comparison described in Phase 1
entries.interpretation: Optum defines cost avoidance as prevention of future expense; it is not recovered money.

entries.source_basis: Captured USAO/IRS-CI sentencing materials in Feeding Our Future corpus
entries.interpretation: The same $47,920,514 restitution figure appears for both defendants in the same Empire Cuisine case family. Treat as an overlap/joint-and-several risk and do not add the two orders into $95.8M without the judgments proving they are independent obligations.

publication_instruction: A public Recovery page should show separate columns/stacks for ordered, identified, potential, collected, forfeited, and avoided. Never display a single 'money recovered' total unless every component is collected and non-overlapping.
